阅读项目背景

项目背景PROJECT BACKGROUND

本项目为赵梦澈快手账号打造辛选超级年货节商业短片，围绕年货采购与源头直采展开。A XinXuan Super New Year campaign film for Zhao Mengche on Kuaishou, centered on direct seasonal sourcing.

以海陆空跨山海的全球物流远征，呈现供应链实力、产地品质与年货盛宴氛围。A global expedition across land, sea and air brings supply-chain scale, origin quality and festive anticipation to life.

辛选集团 / 赵梦澈 / 快手 / 2026 年年货节XINXUAN / ZHAO MENGCHE / KUAISHOU / NEW YEAR CAMPAIGN 2026

全球军事级物流远征军A GLOBAL LOGISTICS EXPEDITION

视觉系统VISUAL SYSTEM

轮船、捕捞船、货车与直升机构成海陆空载具体系，以辛选红、标识和包装维持统一。Ships, fishing vessels, trucks and helicopters share a visual identity through XinXuan red, markings and packaging.

色彩系统COLOR SYSTEM

以辛选红作为跨镜头的品牌锚点；冷蓝与深绿铺陈自然环境，暖金光推动集结收束。XinXuan red anchors the brand; cool blue and forest green shape the environments, while warm gold resolves the gathering.

主色依据报告定义，辅助色依据项目画面归纳。The primary color follows the report; supporting colors are drawn from the project imagery.

跨越山海的海陆空行动AN EXPEDITION ACROSS LAND, SEA AND AIR

视觉创意 / 导演分镜 / 视觉统筹VISUAL CONCEPT / STORYBOARD DIRECTION / VISUAL COORDINATION

GLOBAL

自然伟力 × 工业统治THE FORCE OF NATURE. THE POWER OF INDUSTRY.

以极端环境、巨型载具和有序调度，建立供应链的规模感与可靠感。Extreme environments, monumental vehicles and precise coordination communicate scale and reliability.

超现实巨物奇观 / 军事化调度秩序感SURREAL MONUMENTAL SCALE / MILITARY-PRECISION COORDINATION

01

00:00 – 00:13

全球矩阵GLOBAL MOBILIZATION

海陆空矩阵建立规模感，操作特写将集结推进到行动。Land, sea and air formations establish scale; operational close-ups turn mobilization into action.

辛选红、载具标识与包装形成统一线索；光束、金属风化与热扭曲支撑电影质感。XinXuan red, markings and packaging unify the imagery; light, weathered metal and heat haze add cinematic texture.

02

00:14 – 00:25

大山甄果SOURCING IN THE MOUNTAINS

SOURCE

云雾中的森林交代源头环境；红色车阵深入产地，把品质溯源落在运输行动上。Misty forests reveal the source; red truck convoys translate origin quality into transport in motion.

03

00:26 – 00:34

山河腹地WINE FROM THE HINTERLAND

巨型酒樽建立产地奇观，直升机吊装把品质叙述转化为供应链行动。Monumental wine bottles create a landscape spectacle; helicopter airlifts turn quality into a logistics operation.

04

00:35 – 00:43

极地怒海ACROSS THE SOUTH PACIFIC

风暴强度与船体细节形成反差，捕捞与丰收画面最终落回生鲜价值。Storm intensity contrasts with vessel detail; fishing and harvest imagery return the story to seafood value.

舰队驶入晨光，冷暖变化让远征的紧张感逐渐转为集结的确定感。The fleet enters morning light; a shift from cool to warm turns expedition tension into the certainty of arrival.

05

00:44 – 00:52

万物归仓ALL ROUTES CONVERGE

三路运输汇入港口，集装箱落地完成从寻源到交付的叙事闭环。Three transport routes converge at the port; the container landing closes the journey from sourcing to delivery.

集结完毕THE EXPEDITION IS COMPLETE
